fr.recommendations:
• Install reflective address markers at the driveway entrance visible from the street in both directions.
• Mark all access points clearly so responders arriving from different directions can quickly identify entry options.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain vehicle clearance on both sides.
• Keep the detached structure accessible by maintaining a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure.
• Cut back any vegetation growing against or immediately adjacent to both the main residence and the detached structure.
• Keep the rear access route clear of parked vehicles, stored equipment, and overgrown vegetation.
• Mark or designate a staging area within the parking area large enough for emergency vehicles to turn around.
• Keep gates or barriers controlling rear access unlocked or secured with a method accessible to responders.
• Trim garden and landscaped plantings along walkways so responders can move quickly on foot between the front entry and other areas of the property.
• Post a visible property diagram or address placard at the front entry showing the location of the detached structure and all access points.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from large trees that hang directly over or near the house.
• Thin trees within the cluster closest to the structure to create more space between individual trees.
• Remove or cut back ground vegetation growing beneath scattered trees near the house.
• Keep the area directly against the foundation and walls clear of shrubs and low-growing plants.
• Trim lower branches from scattered trees near the structure so flames cannot climb from the ground into the tree canopy.
• Mow or cut back ground vegetation in open areas between the trees and the house.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and overgrown vegetation along their edges.
• Remove any dead branches, leaves, or plant debris that has collected under trees near the structure.
